project.purpose: Source-qualified existing Agent Skills bridge responsibilities: source admission, context discovery and revision-fenced resource read. These are distinct from the Skill content/methods they expose.

nodes.label: SkillSourceQualification
nodes.responsibility: Find Agent Skills packages within configured sources and preserve package validity, trust, quarantine, visibility and source identity before recommending content.
nodes.authority: Agent Skills source/provider retains package and trust facts; this bridge only exposes bounded discovery and file access
inputs: configured SkillSource roots, package bytes, Agent Skills frontmatter, trust/eligibility context
outputs: typed SkillRecord inventory and source-scoped admission/quarantine status
nodes.behavioralContract: Reject path-unsafe/nonconforming package and quarantine detected credential material; raw inventory remains separate from effective admitted projection. Not a global Skill truth registry.
acceptance: Invalid metadata and hostile packages are not silently promoted as trusted invocation.
Source inventory distinguishes disabled/ineligible/quarantined from not found.
nodes.replacementCondition: Retain Agent Skills identity, trust, discovery, exact revision fences and path containment; substitute the bridge with a standards-native provider only after matching native consumers and stale-package negatives.

nodes.label: ContextualSkillDiscovery
nodes.responsibility: Project visible effective Skill candidates and source-qualified ranked search for an Agent context, without invoking a Skill.
nodes.authority: Agent Skills source/provider retains package and trust facts; this bridge only exposes bounded discovery and file access
outputs: context-bound effective SkillView, snapshotRevision and candidate matches
nodes.behavioralContract: Fully-qualified identity is distinguished from name precedence; a missing match, ineligible candidate or source-health gap cannot be converted into an implicit execution recommendation.
acceptance: Search cannot return ineligible/quarantined records as admitted usable Skills.
Resolution precedence is deterministic and binds the exact snapshot revision.
nodes.replacementCondition: Retain Agent Skills identity, trust, discovery, exact revision fences and path containment; substitute the bridge with a standards-native provider only after matching native consumers and stale-package negatives.

nodes.label: RevisionFencedSkillRead
nodes.responsibility: Resolve and read an exact Skill resource under instruction, package and catalog snapshot revision fences and confined filesystem paths.
nodes.authority: Agent Skills source/provider retains package and trust facts; this bridge only exposes bounded discovery and file access
outputs: bounded immutable resource bytes, qualified source read or explicit fail-closed error
nodes.behavioralContract: Snapshot mismatch, file/package revision drift, path escape or symlink escape rejects the read; returned content remains advisory, not executable authority.
acceptance: A stale snapshot or mutated package cannot be silently read as the prior binding.
A parent-traversing/symlink resource cannot escape the selected Skill root.
nodes.replacementCondition: Retain Agent Skills identity, trust, discovery, exact revision fences and path containment; substitute the bridge with a standards-native provider only after matching native consumers and stale-package negatives.

edges.label: Read consumes exact qualified resolved identity and snapshot
Resource read rechecks original package and instruction identity

slices.objective: Existing Skills bridge source qualification, selection, and safe exact resource read have independently described R2.1 contracts and native consumer evidence.
acceptance: Source, trusted manifest and consumer tests resolve to exact Git objects.
Negative tests demonstrate unsafe package and stale snapshot rejection.
No new skills index or execution authority is introduced.
slices.nextAction: Compare installed Skills exact package revision with source and identify real Agent consumers before any installed/behavioral cross-boundary proof.

gaps: This source plan does not establish globally current project-vs-installed Skill package identity.
Discovery tests cannot prove model agents actually use or understand a Skill.
The underlying Skill content is a method LEGO only when actual goal and consumers justify it.

review.basis: Current protected main Git 75fc00bdec12268bd92ad85c6138b6f1be76bf3d; existing catalog+MCP source and native tests
